title: Regular Food on Hand and Tailwise Autoship Prescription Diet Days
content:
Regular food bought recently takes days off the diet days of a new prescription diet Autoship (an Autoship Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship for the pet's Rx Prescription Diet prescription). The purchase is read from the customer's Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders records: the latest one-time order line of food charged to the customer.

- Latest such line charged no more than 14 days ago: 3 days come off.
- Charged more than 14 but no more than 45 days ago: 1 day comes off.
- Otherwise (charged more than 45 days ago, or no such line): no days come off.

Its age is the calendar days from the charge date to the day the value is worked out.

| Hypothetical latest food line | Days off |
|---|---|
| 14 days ago | 3 |
| 15 days ago | 1 |
| 45 days ago | 1 |
| 46 days ago | none |
